title: Tata Steel CEO Warns Against China's 130M Ton Steel Dump | TV Narendran Speaks
dek: Tata Steel CEO TV Narendran has warned against China's 130M ton steel dump, according to Business Today.
summary: Tata Steel CEO TV Narendran has warned against what the headline describes as China's 130M ton steel dump, according to Business Today. The publisher provided no excerpt, so the context, the period covered and any policy asks are not stated.
keyFacts: TV Narendran warns against China's 130M ton steel dump
whyItMatters: Large Chinese export volumes weigh on global prices and on Indian mills' margins. Industry leaders are likely to press for continued trade protection.
implications: Buyers may continue to see import price pressure. Producers are likely to keep lobbying for safeguard measures.

related.title: Chinese steel imports remain a threat to Indian industry: Tata Steel CEO
related.dek: Tata Steel's T V Narendran says Chinese imports remain a threat as domestic steelmakers continue talks with the government on protective measures.

related.title: Tata Steel eyes 50 mt capacity in India, to pump 75% of capex into domestic growth: TV Narendran
related.dek: Tata Steel is eyeing 50 mt of capacity in India and will direct 75% of capex to domestic growth, with Maharashtra a possible major destination, The Hindu BusinessLine reports.

related.title: Tata Steel's 40 mtpa domestic capacity target slips by upto five years
related.dek: Tata Steel expects its 40 mtpa domestic capacity target to arrive three to five years late, Mint reports, as it seeks government support for green steel in the Netherlands.

related.title: Tata Steel MD Explains Differing Views on EU Steel Carbon Duties
related.dek: Tata Steel's managing director has explained why views differ on the European Union's carbon duties on steel, according to Asianet Newsable.
